name: lia-plugins
description: Lia Creative's Claude Code tooling. The home for everything the team installs to prototype and build — start with the prototyping pair.

plugins.name: squeaks
plugins.description: Scaffold and drive deliberately-rough, copy-first lo-fi prototypes. Describe an idea, get a clickable wireframe. Use when the thinking isn't finished yet.

plugins.name: design-and-refine
plugins.description: Generate distinct UI variations in an existing repo, compare side-by-side, collect feedback, and synthesize a refined version. Use for hi-fi work on real components.

plugins.name: lia-toys
plugins.description: How Lia builds toys with agents. The orchestrator skill: one long-lived session runs the board, decides the order, writes the dispatches, verifies what comes back and merges it — and never ships code itself. Use when several tickets are in flight or a milestone has a deadline.

plugins.name: ticket-builder
plugins.description: How Lia builds Linear tickets and epics properly — ticket/epic shapes, priority-and-dependency ordering, blocked-by sequencing, vault-grounded sources, team/label/status conventions, and the doc-vs-ticket line. Use when breaking work into Linear issues.
